say:1:1122305001:1.text: We've accepted the Buckthorn Caravan's bounty so that should be our top priority right now.
say:1:1122305001:1.source_cn: 我已经接取了红沙棘商队的悬赏，现在最要紧的就是这件事。

say:2:1122305002:1.text: And as for Grayhorn... If he wants to leave, let him! No one's stopping him!
say:2:1122305002:1.source_cn: 至于老憨……他要走就走！没人拦他！

say:3:1122305003:1.text: Once we deal with those bandits, we'll become famous in Alkali, and he'll be begging to come back!

say:4:1122305004:1.text: But first, you've got one last skill to learn.

say:6:1122305005:1.text: Relax, it'll be a piece of cake.

say:7:1122305008:1.text: The key skill for any bounty hunter—<style="highlight">disguises</style>.

say:8:1122305009:1.text: Sometimes you can only gain valuable intel by venturing into dangerous territories. This often means infiltrating enemy groups.
say:8:1122305009:1.source_cn: 很多有价值的情报，必须深入险境才能获得。最常见的情况，...

say:9:1122305010:1.text: To pull this off, you'll need to be able to change your appearance and mimic everything about them. From their speech patterns to their attitude, everything has to be spot on.
say:9:1122305010:1.source_cn: 想做到这一点，除了要换上合适的装扮，还得模仿对方的一举...

choice_prompt:10:1122305010.text: To pull this off, you'll need to be able to change your appearance and mimic everything about them. From their speech patterns to their attitude, everything has to be spot on.
choice_prompt:10:1122305010.source_cn: 想做到这一点，除了要换上合适的装扮，还得模仿对方的一举一动。小到说话的口吻，大到脾气性格，都不能出错。

say:11:1122305012:1.text: There's a camp <style="highlight">southeast of Alkali</style> where many bounty hunters are sniffing around for clues about these bandits.

say:12:1122305013:1.text: Unfortunately, Wildclaw and I are pretty well-known around these parts and we're on bad terms with them, so we won't get a peep out of them. We're counting on you.
say:12:1122305013:1.source_cn: 我和烈爪是熟面孔，又一向和他们不对付，指定半个字也问不...

say:13:1122305014:1.text: Plus, the bandits' hideout is also in the southeast. Maybe you'll get more details on their location.

say:14:1122305015:1.text: I've sent Wildclaw ahead to wait for you, he'll teach you how to disguise yourself and blend in.
say:14:1122305015:1.source_cn: 我已经先让烈爪过去等你了，他会教你怎么混入其中的。
say:14:1122305015:1.male: I've sent Wildclaw ahead to wait for you, he'll teach you how to disguise yourself and blend in.

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 你又想让我去哪打探情报？

say:16:1122305011:1.text: Hey hey, don't get overconfident now.
say:16:1122305011:1.source_cn: 这事没那么容易，你别高兴得太早。

say:18:1122305007:1.text: Besides, what I'll be teaching you today is something Grayhorn will never master.
